OHADA member states

The OHADA zone covers 17 states across Central and West Africa, all using the same accounting framework (SYSCOHADA) and the same legal structures.

Benin Burkina Faso Cameroon Central African Republic Chad Comoros Congo (Brazzaville) Côte d'Ivoire Democratic Republic of Congo Gabon Guinea Guinea-Bissau Mali Niger Senegal Togo Equatorial Guinea
